```{r libraries}
#load in packages
library(rio)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(effsize)
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r data path}
#find data path 
file_path <- file.path('../../experiments/click-and-switch/data/deepucontrol_behavioral_data')

csv_path <- list.files(path = file_path, pattern = ".*DeepuControl.*\\.csv$", recursive = T, full.names = T)

```

```{r loop}
#loop to pull columns of interest from each csv 
dc_control_allsubs <- c()

for(i in 1:length(csv_path)){
   if(i %in% c(36, 47, 83, 99)){ #remove participant 84, ran as 83; remove 7, 37, and 47 because those IDs aren't in the CS df
     next
     }
  
  data <- read.csv(csv_path[i])

  data <- data %>%
    select(participant, left_event_frame, right_event_frame, video_name,
           correct_answer, TemMem_resp.keys, TemMem_resp.corr,
           TemMem_resp.rt, TimePer_resp.keys, TimePer_resp.rt
           )
  
  data <- na.omit(data)
  
  dc_control_allsubs <- rbind(dc_control_allsubs, data)
}

```

```{r}
#import click and switch data 
cs_og_allsubs <- import("~/workspace/click-and-switch/c+s_beh_tempmem.csv")

#filter c+s data by subj IDs in the control 
cs_og_allsubs <- cs_og_allsubs %>%
  filter(Subject_ID %in% dc_control_allsubs$video_name) %>%
  filter(Filter_0_instruction_1_task == 1) %>%
  distinct(Subject_ID, left_event_frame, right_event_frame, .keep_all =T) %>%
  na.omit()

```

```{r}
#combine og and control together, and add a column that has "control" vs. "OG" 
cs_og_allsubs <- cs_og_allsubs[-c(1,3,5)]

cs_og_allsubs$TemMem_resp.rt <- as.numeric(cs_og_allsubs$TemMem_resp.rt)

names(dc_control_allsubs)[names(dc_control_allsubs) == 'video_name'] <- 'Subject_ID'

#first, left join the app switch and event switch with the appropriate matches in the deepu control (join by in the order the columns present themselves)
dc_join <- left_join(dc_control_allsubs, select(cs_og_allsubs, left_event_frame, right_event_frame, Subject_ID, App_1_BothLecture_2_BothInsta_3_diff, SwitchEvent_0_no_1_yes, Exclude_0_no_1_yes), by = join_by(left_event_frame, right_event_frame, Subject_ID))

dc_cs_combined <- full_join(cs_og_allsubs, dc_join, join = join_by(left_event_frame, right_event_frame, Subject_ID))

#now join the control and the OG 
full_combined <- full_join(dc_join, cs_og_allsubs)

#label OG and control 
full_combined$version <- ifelse(is.na(full_combined$participant), "OG", "control")
```

```{r exclusions}
#excluded_ids <- c("CS_702", "CS_703", "CS_705", "CS_709", "CS_717", "CS_721", "CS_735", "CS_748", "CS_774", "CS_771", "CS_772", "CS_802", "CS_831")

full_combined <- full_combined %>%
  filter(!Subject_ID %in% excluded_ids)

#now remove all bad trials
full_combined <- full_combined %>%
  filter(Exclude_0_no_1_yes == 0 & App_1_BothLecture_2_BothInsta_3_diff != 0)
```

```{r temp order memory analyses}
tempmem_allsubs$App_1_BothLecture_2_BothInsta_3_diff <- as.factor(tempmem_allsubs$App_1_BothLecture_2_BothInsta_3_diff)
#tempmem_allsubs$SwitchEvent_0_no_1_yes <- as.factor(tempmem_allsubs$SwitchEvent_0_no_1_yes)

#descriptives (mean, standard deviation)
tempmem_descriptives <- aggregate(tempmem_allsubs, TemMem_resp.corr ~  App_1_BothLecture_2_BothInsta_3_diff + SwitchEvent_0_no_1_yes + `Subject_ID`, function(x) c(mean = mean(x), sd = sd(x)))
  

#LME: effects of switch category and event continuity 
tempmem_lme <- lmer(data = tempmem_allsubs, TemMem_resp.corr ~ App_1_BothLecture_2_BothInsta_3_diff 
                    * SwitchEvent_0_no_1_yes + (1 | Subject_ID))
summary(tempmem_lme)
anova(tempmem_lme)

#estimated marginal means 
emmeans <- emmeans(tempmem_lme, ~App_1_BothLecture_2_BothInsta_3_diff * SwitchEvent_0_no_1_yes, pbkrtest.limit = 10189)
pairs(emmeans, by = "SwitchEvent_0_no_1_yes")

tempmem <- tempmem_descriptives %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = TemMem_resp.corr, names_from = c(App_1_BothLecture_2_BothInsta_3_diff, SwitchEvent_0_no_1_yes))
```
